about: Trial run of batch (Seaware CRM Data Sync - Incremental). Expectations come from the old Mule flows: interfaceFlow -> batch-implSub_Flow (Seaware, oss-implSub_Flow) -> Batch_zoho_modules (reservations, contacts via guest identity, linking, cabin info, add-ons, group/agency, voyages, invoices; shorex is switched off in the old code) -> error rows (db-sys) for refused records; Global_Error_Handler e-mails flow errors. Redis is not in the closed room, so progress is kept in memory. The trial switches the OSS copy on in the closed room, whatever the live setting says.

interfaceFlow.name: normal delta run
interfaceFlow.about: two pages from Seaware: page kept in OSS, every CRM module written as in Batch_zoho_modules; guests without cabin or add-ons give error rows

interfaceFlow.name: nothing new
interfaceFlow.about: Seaware has no changed reservations: nothing is written, nothing kept, no e-mail

interfaceFlow.name: zoho down
interfaceFlow.about: the CRM answers 500: retried (old http-error-retrySub_Flow), then the block is kept as failed (old Batch_Step_Failure) and the run goes on; no e-mail

interfaceFlow.name: seaware sign-in refused
interfaceFlow.about: old Global_Error_Handler: the error is e-mailed, nothing is written

interfaceFlow.name: guest service down
interfaceFlow.about: guest identity answers 503: the guests are refused and written as error rows, the other modules go on

interfaceFlow.name: links exist
interfaceFlow.about: the CRM already links a guest who left the reservation: the link is set inactive with PUT (old zohoUpdate_linkingRequest_Sub_Flow)

interfaceFlow.name: oss down
interfaceFlow.about: OSS refuses the page copy: as in the old flow the run stops before the CRM and the error is e-mailed

interfaceFlow.name: shorex switched on
interfaceFlow.about: with sync.writeShorex = true the ported shorex step searches and writes Shorex
